label: SSA form and phi nodes
subgoals: Rename each assignment to a fresh version
Insert a phi at each join where versions merge
Map a join phi to a multiplexer and a header phi to a loop-carried register

label: Arrays, pointers, calls and widths
subgoals: Map large arrays to RAMs with limited ports
Keep possibly aliasing accesses in program order
Narrow every type to the width the algorithm needs

label: Optimizations that reshape the graph
subgoals: Replace constant multiplies by shifts and adds
Rebalance associative integer chains to cut depth
Shrink registers to the proven value range
